final: WITH a AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS av FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), m AS (SELECT AVG(av) AS mv FROM a) SELECT a.event_name, a.av AS avg_budget_amount, a.av - m.mv AS diff_above_mean, a.av / m.mv AS ratio_to_mean FROM a, m WHERE a.av > m.mv
